standard.summary: 启用 PyTorch DDP（Distributed Data Parallel）多 GPU 训练。每张 GPU 处理独立的 batch，梯度通过 AllReduce 同步。
standard.effect: 2 张 GPU 约提速 1.8-1.9 倍（不是完美 2 倍，因为通信开销）。num_processes 指定 GPU 数量。
standard.whenToUse: 有多张 GPU 且想加速训练时。
standard.avoidWhen: 单 GPU 时不要开启。与 block swap 不兼容。

standard_en.summary: Enables PyTorch DDP (Distributed Data Parallel) multi-GPU training. Each GPU handles its own batch and the gradients are synchronised by AllReduce.
standard_en.effect: Two GPUs give roughly a 1.8-1.9x speedup (not a perfect 2x, because of communication overhead). num_processes gives the number of GPUs.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you have several GPUs and want to speed training up.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not enable it on a single GPU. It is not compatible with block swap.

advanced.principle: DDP 在每张 GPU 上运行完整的训练循环，每步 optimizer.step() 前通过 NCCL AllReduce 同步所有 GPU 的梯度。ddp_gradient_as_bucket_view=True 将梯度放入连续内存桶中减少通信开销。ddp_static_graph=True 在图不变时进一步优化。ddp_find_unused_parameters 检测未使用的参数（调试用，训练时关闭）。
advanced.intervention: entry_train.py 通过 torch.distributed.launch 启动多进程。
advanced.expectedImpact: 接近线性的加速比。2 GPU ≈ 1.85x，4 GPU ≈ 3.5x。
advanced.tradeoffs: main_process_ip/port 配置多机训练的网络。nccl_socket_ifname 指定网络接口。

advanced_en.principle: DDP runs the full training loop on every GPU, syncing all GPUs' gradients via NCCL AllReduce before each optimizer.step(). ddp_gradient_as_bucket_view=True puts gradients into contiguous memory buckets to cut communication overhead. ddp_static_graph=True optimizes further when the graph is fixed. ddp_find_unused_parameters detects unused parameters (for debugging; keep off in training).
advanced_en.intervention: entry_train.py launches multiple processes via torch.distributed.launch.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: main_process_ip/port configures multi-node networking. nccl_socket_ifname specifies the network interface.
